scripts.check: npm --prefix functions run check && npm --prefix web run check
scripts.test: npm --prefix functions test && npm --prefix web test
scripts.build: npm --prefix functions run build && npm --prefix web run build
scripts.emulators: npm --prefix functions run build && firebase emulators:start
scripts.emulators:e2e: npm --prefix functions run build && firebase emulators:start --config firebase.e2e.json --project demo-aimasho-e2e --only auth,firestore,functions
scripts.deploy:backend: npm --prefix functions run build && firebase deploy --project aimasho --only functions,firestore --non-interactive
scripts.deploy: npm run check && npm run deploy:backend && npm run deploy:web && npm run deploy:hosting
